contradictions.what: Rep first says Tallowfield was building a portal, later says Paul's team builds nothing and the portal is off the shelf with a plugin.
Rep first believed the trigger was the portal, then says the real trigger was the new CFO's close problem and the portal was an excuse.
Rep says she doesn't know what Fiserv showed them, yet reports Ines got more annoyed after the bank call. Competitor read rests on Ines's account only.
Rep had it at 20 percent and 'dead' before the data meeting, yet says after that it was 'paperwork'. Earlier-stage confidence seems inconsistent with CFO engagement at the demo.
Customer asked for a distributor reference, never received one, and signed anyway; a stated requirement did not block the deal.
Rep says Ines 'sat on' the first proposal, but later explains Paul forwarded it and she read only the first page; stall was in the routing, not a deliberate hold.
